Claim 1 (Currently amended): An alarm system comprising: a physiological monitor capable of triggering a first alarm in response to an alarm condition, wherein the first alarm is an audible alarm.

Claim 2 (Original): The system of claim 1, wherein the second alarm is capable of being acknowledged by an operator input before expiration of a timer.

Claim 16 (Currently amended): A system comprising: a processor programmed to trigger an alarm in response to an alarm condition; a memory capable of storing alarm data associated with the alarm, wherein the alarm data comprises an alarm type and a time that the alarm was triggered; and a display capable of displaying the alarm data, wherein the alarm data includes information about the first alarm and the second alarm.

Claim 17 (Original): The system of claim 18, wherein the system is part of a physiological monitor or a central management system.

Claim 18 (Original): The system of claim 18, wherein the alarm data comprises information about a level of escalation of the alarm.

Claim 19 (Original): The system of claim 18, wherein the alarm data comprises information about an acknowledgement of the alarm.

Claim 20 (Original): The system of claim 18, wherein the processor is programmed to send the alarm data to one or more wireless devices.
